decisions.question: Ear fan (R03 front, R04 rear): what should the fur read as? Three methods and three tools since round 21 (164M tokens) kept nothing. decisions.answer: Nick 2026-10-08: tone the spikiness down a little and rely on the fur texture added later instead of building fur out of shapes. The fan keeps its outline, V tilt, cups and pale inner tufts as soft masses; no new lock geometry.
